summary: Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) argues that E‑Rate subsidies for Wi‑Fi on school buses are wasteful and urges the FCC to rescind the rule permitting such use. CAGW argues the FCC should assess school and library broadband needs based on BEAD eligibility and eliminate duplication with other federal or private broadband efforts to reduce waste.
